mapper.sql: id, user_id, diary_id, summary, emotion_json, topics_json, entities_json, recent_state_json, long_term_facts_json, schema_version, prompt_version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diary_analysis (user_id, diary_id, summary, emotion_json, topics_json, entities_json, recent_state_json, long_term_facts_json, schema_version, prompt_version) VALUES (#{userId}, #{diaryId}, #{summary}, CAST(#{emotionJson} AS JSON), CAST(#{topicsJson} AS JSON), CAST(#{entitiesJson} AS JSON), CAST(#{recentStateJson} AS JSON), CAST(#{longTermFactsJson} AS JSON), #{schemaVersion}, #{promptVersion}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = VALUES(user_id), summary = VALUES(summary), emotion_json = VALUES(emotion_json), topics_json = VALUES(topics_json), entities_json = VALUES(entities_json), recent_state_json = VALUES(recent_state_json), long_term_facts_json = VALUES(long_term_facts_json), schema_version = VALUES(schema_version), prompt_version = VALUES(prompt_version)
